rationale: The base station was online with uplink OK, no error codes, and only 5/16 capacity used, ruling out network, capacity, and storage causes. The new SEN-D1 sensor (firmware 1.0, protocol v2) was confirmed compatible with the base station (4.2, supports v2/v3), and its battery was 100%. The pairing timed out at 120s with no fault codes, and a guided retry — holding SYNC for a full 3 seconds with the sensor within 1 metre of the base station — succeeded immediately, confirming a procedural pairing issue rather than a hardware or protocol fault.

repair_steps: Guide the customer to retry pairing: put the base station into pairing mode via the app, then hold the sensor's SYNC button for 3 seconds until its LED blinks blue, keeping the sensor within 1 metre of the base station.
Confirm the sensor appears online in the app and reports RSSI and battery correctly.
Close the ticket as resolved at L1.
